A slip: a printed strip showing the card type line and its corrected game text, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its ''Decipher Errata'' sheet dated 1 March 2017 (the PDF was made on 31 May 2017).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Premiere-D-ifindyourlackoffaith-PC-Errata-2017-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[I Find Your Lack Of Faith Disturbing (PC Errata 2013 slip)]] (16 April 2013): Same words as the 2013 slip. The black strip keeps the white italic “E” but no longer prints the title.

The 2013 slip and the 2017 slip, each as cut from its sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
